recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the createdBy extension needs future semantic changes, make them in the FHIR Extensions Pack rather than reintroducing an extension definition under core source/valueset.
issue_request: FHIR-29549 is a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request for R5 asking for an extension on ValueSet.compose to capture the user who created the compose, with description 'User who created the compose for the ValueSet.'
initial_application: Core history shows the request was applied implicitly by 054eabf311, which added source/valueset/structuredefinition-extension-valueset-compose-createdBy.xml during the R5 ValueSet/VSD work. Later history retained the canonical createdBy spelling and dd468d4f17 deliberately removed extension definitions from the R5 core source as part of the extension-source migration.
additional_context: The current core checkout has no active source/valueset extension definition for this URL, but source/oids.ini still registers http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/valueset-compose-createdBy to OID 2.16.840.1.113883.4.642.5.1218. The FHIR Extensions Pack is the maintained home for standard extensions referenced by core and currently defines valueset-compose-createdBy with ValueSet.compose context, string value type, Vocab ownership, and the requested description; the permanent 5.3.0 published page exposes the same semantics. FHIR-29548 is a companion VSDP issue for the compose creationDate extension but was not decided here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding the StructureDefinition to core would be wrong because the definition already exists in the extension pack and the core source removal was intentional.

related_jiras.note: Companion Published/Persuasive VSDP issue for ValueSet.compose creationDate, referenced in the same Confluence planning evidence and also hosted in the FHIR Extensions Pack; not decided by this seed audit.
